svg.title: Two by hand, then the helper, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the two Lesson 3-2 tests on a 4 by 4 taped grid. In step 1 the robot starts on a segment facing the next intersection. It tracks to that intersection and drives past it so its wheels sit on it, then does the same again and stops on the second intersection. In step 2 it starts from the same spot and drive_intersections(3) repeats the pair three times, arriving at three intersections in a row and stopping on the third. Beside it, the steps of each test, with the one running highlighted.
svg.text: Two by hand, then the helper, from above
Each drive past leaves the sensors just
beyond the intersection, so the next
track starts on plain line and goes on
to the next one. The loop just repeats it.

g.text: the second track started past the first
